units.source_text: 那天晚上，我去了先生下榻的旅店。

en.t: That evening, I went to the inn where Sensei was staying.

units.source_text: 虽说是旅店，却不同于一般的旅店，那是一幢建在宽阔寺院内的别墅般的建筑物。

en.t: Although it was called an inn, it was not like an ordinary inn; it was a villa-like building set within the spacious grounds of a temple.

units.source_text: 我还了解到住在那里的人并非先生的家眷。

en.t: I also learned that the people living there were not members of Sensei's family.

units.source_text: 由于我老是“先生、先生”的叫他，先生露出了苦笑。

en.t: Because I kept calling him Sensei, Sensei, he gave a wry smile.

units.source_text: 我解释说，这是我对长辈的习惯叫法。

en.t: I explained that this was simply my habitual way of addressing my elders.

units.source_text: 当我向他打听前几天见过的洋人时，

en.t: When I asked him about the Westerner I had seen a few days earlier,

units.source_text: 先生告诉我那个洋人性情古怪，现在已经不在镰仓了。

en.t: Sensei told me that the man was eccentric and was no longer in Kamakura.

units.source_text: 闲聊一阵之后，先生说，奇怪的是，自己跟日本人都不大来往，

en.t: After we had chatted for a while, Sensei said it was strange that he hardly associated even with Japanese people,

units.source_text: 却和那个外国人有交往。

en.t: yet had become acquainted with that foreigner.

units.source_text: 最后我对先生说，总觉得在哪里见过他，就是想不起来。

en.t: Finally, I told Sensei that I felt as though I had seen him somewhere before, but simply could not remember where.

units.source_text: 那个时候，年轻的我暗中猜测先生是不是也有着同我一样的感觉，

en.t: At that time, in my youth, I secretly wondered whether Sensei might have the same feeling about me,

units.source_text: 所以对先生的回答满怀期待。

en.t: and so I waited for his answer with great expectation.

units.source_text: 但是，先生沉吟片刻后说：“我不记得见过你，怕是认错了吧？”

en.t: But after thinking in silence for a moment, Sensei said, I do not remember having seen you. Perhaps you have mistaken me for someone else?
I felt, rather strangely, a certain disappointment.
